title: MCP servers
description: Shared configuration for all six AI chat tools. Commands run on this host. Idle sessions reload before the next message; running sessions apply changes after their current reply. Computer use is authorized separately.
duplicate: MCP server names must be unique.
name: Server name
secrets: Saved environment variables and headers appear as ********. Keep the placeholder to preserve the existing value.
allTools: Use with all AI chat tools
stringMap: Environment variables and headers must be JSON objects containing only string values.
invalidName: Use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. yi_computer_use is reserved for the built-in server.
urlRequired: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
chooseTool: Select at least one tool, or select use with all tools.
stringArray: Arguments must be a JSON string array; use "" for an empty argument.
